description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

description.zh: 修改后的IP地址或者域名。
description.en: The IP address or domain name.

description.zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码。
description.en: The ID of the address. This ID uniquely identifies the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
修改后的地址健康状态判定条件：

- any_ok：所有探测模板至少一个探测正常。

- p30_ok：所有探测模板至少30%探测正常。

- p50_ok：所有探测模板至少50%探测正常。

- p70_ok：所有探测模板至少70%探测正常。

- all_ok：所有探测模板全部探测正常。
description.en:
The new condition for determining the health state of the address. Valid values:

*   any_ok: The health check results of at least one health check template are normal.
*   p30\_ok: The health check results of at least 30% of health check templates are normal.
*   p50\_ok: The health check results of at least 50% of health check templates are normal.
*   p70\_ok: The health check results of at least 70% of health check templates are normal.
*   all_ok: The health check results of all health check templates are normal.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --name Address-1 --address 223.5.XX.XX --attribute-info '当前版本不支持此参数，不需要传入此参数。' --health-judgement p50_ok --health-tasks Port=80 TemplateId=mtp-895180524251000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateCloudGtmAddress --region cn-hangzhou --AttributeInfo '当前版本不支持此参数，不需要传入此参数。' --HealthJudgement p50_ok --HealthTasks '[{"Port":80,"TemplateId":"mtp-895180524251000000"}]' --Address '223.5.XX.XX' --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000' --AddressId 'addr-895182181143680000' --Name 'Address-1'
